key_concepts: Mole is the unit used to quantify amount of substance or number of particles
One mole is equal to 6.02 x 10^23 particles
Molar mass is the mass of one mole of a substance in grams per mole
Percentage composition is the mass of each element in a compound divided by the total comp
Percent composition can be calculated from a compound's chemical formula and atomic masses
The sum of the percent compositions of all elements in a compound is about 100%
Empirical formula shows the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms in a compound
Molecular formula gives the actual number of atoms of each element in a molecule
Glucose has an empirical formula CH2O and a molecular formula C6H12O6
To find an empirical formula from percent composition, assume a 100 g sample and convert e
Dividing each molar amount by the smallest molar amount gives the whole-number atom ratio
Percentage composition is applied in reading food labels, fertilizers, and checking amount
